why_zip_sha256_differs_from_split_archiv: The Census Bureau csv_pus.zip is one container with psam_pusa.csv, psam_pusb.csv, and ACS2024_PUMS_README.pdf. HESI_Person_Part_1.zip / HESI_Person_Part_2.zip are the same two CSVs re-compressed as separate ZIPs without the README. ZIP-level SHA-256 therefore differs; uncompressed CSV SHA-256 and ZIP CRC-32 of those two members are identical.
verification_policy: Never accept an archive because its filename looks official. Accept split ZIPs only if ZIP SHA-256 matches the R2.4 lock. Accept a combined Census ZIP only if each required inner CSV SHA-256 matches inner_csv_sha256. Do not skip checksums.
